input.free_text_description: This system is a file management platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including project, user, address, employee id. The platform provides capabilities for ses processor, hello, user. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage project records, so that I can track and organize project data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage address records, so that I can track and organize address data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage employee id records, so that I can track and organize employee id data effectively.
